run_id: rerun-bc15b89 driver passes 1-20, all five scenarios
steps: Bot decent, 8 seeds per pass, 20 passes (seeds 101-2008), three choice policies (alt, RELEASE, CORP), --clock=fast, per scenario.
Sim: python3 tools/sim.py --mc 200 --seed 1 [--real], events block, 'decent full tree (ref)' and 'decent no skills' rows.
expected: Bot decent win rate close to the sim's decent win rate (sim full tree ref 100% in all five scenarios; no skills 86-96% default, 58-84% --real).
actual: Bot decent win rate 38% (baseline), 37% (trip-cost-90), 35% (decent-4-lanes), 34% (trip-cost-90-4-lanes), 17% (cargo-34). Bot decent does not agree with the sim. Bot decent wins only 26-30 cycles (median 28-30). Per-batch spread in baseline 0.29-0.50 (sd 0.055).

expected: Skill purchases change decent's win rate only as far as the sim's skill rows say (sim full tree 100%).
actual: With all 13 skills skipped, decent wins 8/8 (cycles 21-24). With the bot's own skill choices (B1, B2, C1, A1, A2, C2 seen in the run), decent wins 38%. The skill path the bot chooses is the likely cause of the gap to the sim. Not confirmed.

run_id: qa-head ablation determinism check (before event-RNG seeding)
steps: Scratch copy of HEAD d173a4c, qa/bots/run_batch.sh TAG=all EXTRA='--clock=fast' STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS='1 2' (run twice).
Compare final_cash for seed 1 across invocations.
expected: Same seed and same configuration give the same run.
actual: Seed 1 gave final_cash 8575 (win) in one invocation and 7966 (loss) in another. Cause: game/events.gd setup() calls rng.randomize(), so event picks are unseeded. Fixed in the bot by seeding main.events.rng from --seed (qa/bots/bot_run.gd). Repeat runs now match. Results from the 30-minute balance run predate the fix and cannot be reproduced by seed.
